sources.title: whisper-ar-quran — open audio or speech model | AxForge
sources.snippet: whisper-ar-quran is an open-weight audio or speech model from tarteel-ai. whisper-base-ar-quran (BF16) weighs 290 MB; the smallest configuration that runs it is RTX 3060 12 GB. whisper-ar-quran is an automatic speech recognition model developed by tarteel-ai. It is a fine-tuned version of openai/whisper-base, released under the Apache 2.0 license.
